kebab_example: aliyun rds list-user-backup-files --status CheckSuccess --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --comment BackupTest --backup-id b-kwwvr7v8t7of0000 --oss-url https://0000.oss-ap-0000.aliyuncs.com/backup_qp.xb --tags key1:value1 --resource-group-id rg-acfmy0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListUserBackupFiles

parameters.help_en:
The status of the full backup file. Valid values:

Importing: The full backup file is being imported.
Failed: The full backup file fails to be imported.
CheckSucccess: The full backup file passes the check.
BackupSuccess: The full backup file is imported.
Deleted: The full backup file is deleted
parameters.help_zh:
通过用户备份文件的状态查询目标用户备份。取值：
Importing：导入中。
Failed：导入失败。
CheckSuccess：校验通过。
BackupSuccess：导入成功。
Deleted：已删除
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The description of the full backup file.

The system implements a fuzzy match based on the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
通过备注信息查询目标用户备份。
您可输入目标用户备份的部分备注信息进行模糊匹配
parameters.name: comment

parameters.help_en: The ID of the full backup file
parameters.help_zh: 通过用户备份ID查询目标用户备份
parameters.name: backup_id

parameters.help_en: The URL from which you can download the full backup file that is stored as an object in an Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket. For more information about how to obtain the URL, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/39607.html
parameters.help_zh: 通过用户备份文件的OSS下载地址查询目标用户备份。如何获取用户备份文件的OSS下载地址，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/39607.html
parameters.name: oss_url

parameters.help_en: The tag that is added to the full backup file
parameters.help_zh: 通过标签信息查询目标用户备份
parameters.name: tags

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstanceAttribute operation to obtain the ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

Records.description_en: The information about the full backup files
Records.description_zh: 用户备份文件详情列表

BackupId.description_en: The ID of the full backup file

BinlogInfo.description_en: The information about the binary log file that contains incremental data. If incremental data is generated during the full backup, this parameter is returned
BinlogInfo.description_zh: 备份文件中的Binlog文件信息，备份过程中如有增量内容则会返回此参数

Comment.description_en: The description of the full backup file

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the system started to import the full backup file. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
CreationTime.description_zh: 用户备份的导入开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳。单位：毫秒

Engine.description_en: The database engine of the instance

FinishTime.description_en: The time when the full backup file is successfully imported. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
FinishTime.description_zh: 用户备份成功导入的时间，格式为Unix时间戳。单位：毫秒

ModificationTime.description_en: The time when the full backup file is successfully imported. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
ModificationTime.description_zh: 用户备份的导入完成时间，格式为Unix时间戳。单位：毫秒

OssBucket.description_en: The name of the OSS bucket in which the full backup file is stored as an object
OssBucket.description_zh: 用户备份文件所在的OSS Bucket名称

OssFileMetaData.description_en: The metadata of the full backup file. For more information, see [Manage object metadata]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31859.html）
OssFileMetaData.description_zh: 用户备份文件元信息。更多信息，请参见[管理文件元信息]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31859.html）

OssFileName.description_en: The name of the full backup file that is stored as an object in an OSS bucket
OssFileName.description_zh: OSS中用户备份文件的文件名

OssFilePath.description_en: The path of the full backup file that is stored as an object in an OSS bucket
OssFilePath.description_zh: OSS中用户备份文件的路径

OssFileSize.description_en: The size of the full backup file that is stored as an object in an OSS bucket. Unit: KB
OssFileSize.description_zh: OSS中用户备份文件的大小。单位：KB

OssUrl.description_en: The URL to download the full backup file from the OSS bucket
OssUrl.description_zh: 用户备份文件的OSS下载地址

Reason.description_en: The reason why the full backup file failed to be imported
Reason.description_zh: 用户备份文件导入失败的原因

RestoreSize.description_en: The amount of storage that is required to restore the data of the full backup file. Unit: GB
RestoreSize.description_zh: 还原用户备份所需存储空间大小。单位：GB

Retention.description_en: The retention period of the full backup file. Unit: days
Retention.description_zh: 用户备份文件保留时长。单位：天
